subject: SIG evidence intake: asset ownership & KMS proof (Lynsight)
messages:
From: Asha Patel <asha.patel@lynsight.com>
To: priyom.das@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@lynsight.com, Tom Reynolds <t.reynolds@lynsight.com>
Date: 2027-04-09T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: SIG intake: asset ownership & KMS proofs needed for RFP

Hi Priyom,

Thanks for taking the time yesterday on the discovery call. As part of our RFP/SIG review we need to gather a small packet of controls and supporting evidence to close the technical security review. Our procurement deadline is tight (vendor selection by 4/20), so we'd like to collect the items below by EOD 4/14. Please confirm who's owning each item.

Requested artifacts (high priority):
- Control crosswalk (SIG v2024) with pointers to evidence (spreadsheet preferred)
- Proof of asset ownership for data plane (VPC/subnet diagrams, asset inventory snapshot)
- KMS configuration: key policy, key creation/rotation dates, HSM usage or KMS provider statement
- Access logs showing read/write to customer buckets for a 30-day sample (anonymized)
- SOC 2 / ISO 27001 summary (attestation dates, scope) and the audit contact

Low/optional items:
- Example audit log (redacted) showing an operator action and follow-up ticket
- Diagram of private deployment option (VPC peering / private control plane)

Attachments: I attached our SIG questionnaire extract with the specific controls we're focused on.

Can you confirm receipt and a delivery plan by EOD today? If we need to shift scope I can prioritize which controls matter most for the immediate procurement decision.

Thanks,
Asha Patel
Head of Procurement & Security Operations
Lynsight Analytics

From: priyom.das@redwoodinference.com <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Asha Patel <asha.patel@lynsight.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-09T10:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG intake: asset ownership & KMS proofs needed for RFP

Hi Asha — got it, thanks. We're on this and I think we can meet the 4/14 target with a prioritized packet. Plan below and owners (internal):

- SIG control crosswalk (spreadsheet) -> Kimberly Park (will map controls to artifacts and flag gaps)
- Asset ownership / VPC diagram -> Aditya Rao (network diagrams + asset inventory export)
- KMS configuration & key proof -> Priyom Das (I'll collect key policy + rotation history + HSM notes)
- 30-day access log sample & redacted example audit log -> Kimberly (will coordinate log extract and masking)
- SOC 2/ISO summary and auditor contact -> Priyom (we'll include attestation pdf and scope)

I'm attaching a short intake checklist we use internally — I'll also post the working crosswalk to the Drive link below once Kimberly uploads. If you (or Tom) want us to prioritize a smaller set of controls for procurement approval, call that out and we'll compress.

Deliverables timeline:
- 4/11: preliminary crosswalk + v1 KMS policy excerpt (for your internal reviewers)
- 4/13: full artifact packet + attachments uploaded to Drive
- 4/14: final packet delivered (per your deadline)

We will provide file stubs first (PDFs/XLSX) and follow up with self-service access to the evidence folder.

Thanks — Priyom
Priyom Das
Enterprise Security & Solutions
Redwood Inference
(prioritizing: SIG evidence for Lynsight, deal LYN-2027-044)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: priyom.das@redwoodinference.com, Asha Patel <asha.patel@lynsight.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-11T08:36:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG intake: asset ownership & KMS proofs needed for RFP

Hi Asha / Priyom / Aditya — attaching the first-pass crosswalk (sig_control_crosswalk_v1.xlsx) and a short KMS excerpt (redwood_kms_key_policy.pdf). Notes:

- Crosswalk: I've mapped the SIG control identifiers to our internal control names and pointed to specific evidence files. Columns include control id, redwood control owner, evidence file name, and a confidence column (full/gap/partial).
- KMS: Redwood uses customer-dedicated keys for Private deployments (customer-managed KMS). For Hosted API customers we use provider-managed keys (cloud KMS) with documented key policies and rotation schedules. Attached is the policy excerpt for our hosted KMS key (created 2026-09-02, rotation every 365 days). For Private (VPC) customers we can provide a key proof packet if they elect to bring their own keys or if we host in a dedicated HSM—Aditya can confirm availability.
- Asset ownership: Aditya will upload the VPC/subnet diagram and an asset inventory CSV. The inventory includes service hostnames, role tags, and control owners.

Open items / asks for you (Lynsight):
1) Do you need HSM-backed attestations (e.g., FIPS-certified HSM) for the Private deployment option?
2) If you require a 90-day log sample instead of 30, let us know — that will take additional time to redact.

Attachments in this message: sig_control_crosswalk_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), redwood_kms_key_policy.pdf (pdf).

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Hi Kimberly / Priyom — thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments. I pulled a couple of clarifying questions from the engineering/security reviewers here: 

1) For hosted customers you mention provider-managed keys — can you confirm the exact KMS provider and whether Redwood can provide a signed statement of key custody and rotation logs (we need the logs to prove periodic rotation to our auditors)?
2) For Private deployments: can you confirm whether the dedicated option is "customer-managed keys in their KMS" vs "Redwood hosting HSM-backed keys"? The commercial team flagged this as a procurement requirement (we need to know whether key custody is with Lynsight or Redwood).
3) Small ask: can you include the key creation and last rotation timestamps in the KMS excerpt (or point us to the file if already included)?

If you can reply with short answers and drop the final packet to the Drive link you shared, we'll mark the security review as "ready for procurement" and proceed with the vendor committee on 4/20.

Appreciate it — Asha
Asha Patel
Head of Procurement & Security Operations
Lynsight Analytics
